economics.programme_expense: Separate assumed 0.02 bps of the unit notional per original opportunity, including rejected/no-fill; hypothetical operating sensitivity only, not an actual bill. No double-charge.
economics.risk: Existing numerical sizing/evaluation chain called only with genuine complete input contracts. Adapter exposes explicit missing CandidateMeanInputsV1 fields and cannot mint legal candidate/receipt/EligibleSet. No synthetic account or false precise portfolio drawdown.
economics.scope: Unit-notional fixed-horizon price/arithmetic cash sensitivities, not qualified frozen exact-action simulation. No quote/mark/filter/risk/agent/management facts fabricated. Actual programme cash/capital return/drawdown NOT ESTIMABLE.
economics.unit_notional_USDT: 1 per accepted opportunity; independent hypothetical units, no reinvestment or capital/risk qualification; summed cash is a paper sensitivity, not return on an account

period_selection.rule: First chronological quarter after previously inspected June 2025. If known outcome/selection exposure is found BEFORE acquisition, take earliest later entire quarter with no identified use; otherwise retain July–September. Never inspect returns for selection. Audit found no such use. No fallback after outcomes.

population.denominators: Original N and every inclusion/rejection/unavailable/no-fill/censor count. Full N means NOT ESTIMABLE with accepted censors; all arms also compared on identical common complete C. Model-paired predictive metrics on common support, and original-population controls with unsupported predictions refusing opening.
population.primary: Source-complete altcoin first events, BTC/ETH anchors excluded from hypothetical actions. Requires full causal 24h own volatility feature and observed context for model comparisons. Never infer exchange eligibility.
population.roles: S1 plus S6/BTC/ETH price context only; audit all S1–S8/Path B/risk/management/B components. OHLC-capable but unintegrated mechanisms explicitly named; no complete-programme claim.
population.unit: One verified unique S1 first-trigger event from accepted corrected finite-prefix rules; all native cutoffs retained in calendar ledger. All original events/anchors/missingness/refusals preserved. No repeated episode weight.

seals.decision_boundary: Decision pure function receives only immutable availability-filtered prefix/snapshot and prefit model; no outcome callback/store/path. Attempts to request >T or >decision readiness hard fail. Source orchestration may hold archives but cannot expose later data through the decision interface.
seals.one: Commit/push protocol + prior-source pins before new test payload acquisition/outcome access. A metadata-only BTC July checksum was read at Gate A, no prices.
seals.publication_limit: Git sequence proves publication order, not absence of earlier human exposure. Code fixes before reveal require tests/new pre-outcome code seal; no scientific rule changes after reveal.
seals.two: Commit/push calculation entrypoint hashes, model artifacts, complete test decisions/refusals and calendar identity before separate outcome CLI runs. Outcome stage verifies committed hashes and cannot alter decision input/model/policy.

source_scope.July1_context: Use Jan-1 2025 finite prefix continuously through Sep; no reseed at test boundary or in-window gap. Unknown original continuous-live checkpoint remains UNVERIFIED.
source_scope.checksum: Exact official sibling .CHECKSUM SHA-256/name, ZIP CRC/member/schema, CSV SHA-256, duplicate/order/native calendar/finite OHLCV checks before accepted use
source_scope.reuse: Existing 757 verified objects/proofs; H1 Jan–June 2025 for current finite prefix, June M15 for test seed, 2024/2025 development as already retained. No later source expansion. Missing objects remain in original cohort.

stop_rule: One frozen protocol; no test optimization/retraining, new periods or model variants; report all negatives/blocks, push exact-SHA candidate, independent review, STOP.
test_design_label: SEALED_HISTORICAL_REPLAY; human prior exposure cannot be ruled out

uncertainty.limitations: Only one quarter, inspected development and possible human exposure; fewer than20 independent block equivalents is insufficient robust inference; report exploratory intervals only, no capital/value pass. Slices descriptive, no multiplicity-adjusted discovery claim.
uncertainty.method: 10000 paired calendar block resamples of original complete event sums/counts; same draws across arms; UTC Monday one-week and fixed two-week blocks; seed18102026. Ratio-of-sums means, same market calendar; not IID events.
